title: Galloway Fishing Charters
specs: Captain Bob Krausman has over 35 years of experience fishing Chesapeake Bay rockfish
Maximum 6 people for Spring Trophy and Summer Fishing trips

blurb: Guests enjoy fishing trips aboard the Galloway Girl in the Chesapeake Bay targeting rockfish (striped bass). Captain Bob Krausman, with over 35 years of experience, guides guests to the best fishing spots. Trips depart from Middle River, Maryland.
extraNote: Pay deposit via check or credit card through PayPal; balance due at arrival preferably by cash or check · $15 fee applies if balance is paid online · Respect noise levels at private residence meeting point · 1121 Cold Spring Rd., Middle River, Maryland 21220, a private residence with parking, dock carts, pier, and fish-cleaning stations.
